8.label: 8(i)
8.answer: Mass measures inertia; weight is the gravitational force on the body.
8.explanation: They are related by W = mg.

8.label: 8(ii)
8.answer: Mass is measured in kilograms; weight in newtons.
8.explanation: A newton is a unit of force.

8.label: 8(iii)
8.answer: Mass is scalar; weight is a vector.
8.explanation: Weight points along the local gravitational field.

8.label: 8(iv)
8.answer: Mass is independent of position; weight changes when gravity changes.
8.explanation: The same mass weighs less on the Moon.

8.label: 8(v)
8.answer: A beam balance compares masses; a spring balance measures weight.
8.explanation: The spring extends in response to force.
